Motorists to pay less as VAT on fuel cut to 8%
Nairobi, 29 September 2026

Motorists could soon save at the pump after the Treasury was said to have decided that VAT on fuel
is cut to 8 per cent, a source close to the talks told our reporter on Tuesday. The government has
not published the change. Analysts expect pump prices to fall by KSh 10 per litre.
